items.q: How is this different from the website package?
items.a: The website package is a one-time build that ends at launch. The Growth Partnership keeps going: search visibility, content, Google Business Profile, campaigns and reporting are worked on every month and reviewed with you.
₹20,000 per month, with the website design and build included. Advertising spend is separate and paid directly to Google or Meta.
No. The fee covers strategy, management and production. Ad spend is paid by you directly to the platform, so you keep full control and can see exactly where the money goes.

items.q: How long before I see results?
items.a: Paid campaigns can produce enquiries within days. SEO is slower — usually three to six months before rankings and organic enquiries move meaningfully. Anyone promising faster organic results is guessing.

items.q: Can you guarantee first-page Google rankings?
items.a: No, and no honest provider can. Google decides rankings. What can be controlled is the work that improves the odds: technical health, useful content, a complete Google Business Profile, reviews and quality links.

items.q: Do I need to be on every channel?
items.a: No. Channels are chosen around where your customers actually look and compare. A study abroad consultancy and a Dubai contractor need very different mixes.

items.q: I already have a website. Can you still help?
items.a: Yes. Existing sites are audited first. If the foundation is sound, the work goes into search, content and conversion. If it is holding results back, the rebuild is folded into the plan.
Three months, because search and content work needs time to compound. After that it continues month to month with no lock-in.

about.title: Designing for real businesses, not just screens.
paragraphs: I'm Anjana DV , a web designer from Kerala, India . I build websites on WordPress because it lets my clients own their content — every site I deliver is one they can update themselves.

My work spans six industries across two markets — gold-loan companies in Kochi, study-abroad consultancies, Dubai contractors and UAE career firms. That range is deliberate: every industry taught me a different way a website has to earn trust — finance needs credibility, education needs warmth, contracting needs proof.
What you get is a designer who treats your business goal as the brief — then handles layout, copy structure, launch and support so you never touch a line of code.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: Once you provide all your content and information, delivery happens in minimum time — most projects go live within days, not weeks.

faq.q: What do you need from me to start?
faq.a: Text, images, your logo, and a clear idea of the pages you want. The more complete the information, the faster the build — use the planner above to map it out in five taps.

faq.q: Do I get a domain and hosting?
faq.a: Yes — I set up your domain and hosting as part of the project, and hand everything over so you fully own your website.

faq.q: Can I edit the site myself afterwards?
faq.a: Every site is built on WordPress, so yes. You can update text, images and pages without touching code — and I'm always here for support.

faq.q: Can you integrate payments on my store?
faq.a: Yes. For e-commerce I set up WooCommerce with UPI, card and Razorpay payment integration, plus order and inventory management.

faq.q: What support do I get after launch?
faq.a: Launch support, handover training, and ongoing care plans to keep the site fast, secure and current as your business grows.
